name: Lydden Hill
realName: Lydden Hill Race Circuit — the birthplace of rallycross
creator: Bnuuy
notes: The fabled mixed-surface track. Rallycross heats start from a standing grid; about 40% of the lap is gravel, raced segment by segment with its own grip and traction, so tyre choice is a real trade-off. No live equivalent exists, so cd-testrace shows only the new engine here.
